What is a functional specification Functional
Specification
o A functional specification, or VF (Vehicle Function), is a document written by a
professional figure, called a functionalist, in order to have a complete view of the
behavior of a given function.
o In a VF lists any changes made with respect to any previous versions (if there are
any), the available features, the structure, the various nodes of the vehicle that
are involved, the expected behavior in different environmental conditions,
diagnosis and eventual recovery adopted .
o A VF is not related to the component structure.
o Starting from a VF, the software is written.

functionalities in a carPossible
For each of the following features, multiple VFs can be written
- Car access
- Theft Protection
- Guide Aid
- Climate
- Vehicle dynamics
- Management of the electrical and
electronic system
- Braking
- Energy generation and management
- Motopropulsion management
- Interior lighting
- Lighting and external signaling
- Servo assisted movement
- Passive security
- Visibility and wiping
- infotainment
- Instrument panel functions
- NIT

slides.body:
and structured as a VF - NomenclatureApparance
A VF is presented as a document to which a name is given, referred to the function
object of the document, followed by an alphanumeric series.
V stands for Version and R for Release; the Version allows you to version the
functionality according to the set-up, while the Release allows you to take into account
the changes made to the VF in subsequent releases (adaptations to new projects for
example). The name is usually composed of:
Function Name[Fx.Vfx_Rx]

The first part of a VF
consists of the 'Revision
Notes' which is inserted,
by date, the owner of the

slides.body:
and structured as a VF - Functional Diagram -1-Apparance
The functional diagram graphically describes all the interactions related to
the function in question. All connections between the involved nodes and the
related CAN / LIN messages that are exchanged are reported.

slides.title: Strictly confidential. All contents in this document are property of Kineton s.r.l. 2018 and structured as a VF - Functi
slides.body:
and structured as a VF - Functional Diagram -2-Apparance
In addition to the CAN / LIN messages published
on the network, the internal messages of the
component are reported which are exchanged
with the internal modules via a private network.
Usually different colors are
used to identify different
networks such as C1CAN,
C2CAN, C3CAN, BHCAN,
PCAN, LIN and on each
connection branch the name
of the message and the
transmitted and / or received
signal are reported.

slides.title: Strictly confidential. All contents in this document are property of Kineton s.r.l. 2018 and structured as a VF - Functi
slides.body:
and structured as a VF - Functional Diagram -3-Apparance
The nodes drawn with two different colors are those nodes that also
act as gateways, which can in turn be direct or indirect.
The numbers present in the blocks that identify the nodes refer to the
VF from which or to which the signals are transmitted and / or
received.
The outputs of the nodes are not necessarily
directed towards other nodes, but could be acoustic
and / or visual signals directly perceived in the
vehicle by the user, for example an LED.

slides.body:
and structured as a VF - Working conditionsApparance
The working conditions describe the conditions under which the function is operational. You can have
more conditions such as key-on and key-off, or only key-on, etc., this depends on the function.
The operating status for the manettino is shown below.

slides.title: Strictly confidential. All contents in this document are property of Kineton s.r.l. 2018 and structured as a VF - Functi
slides.body:
and structured as a VF - Function description -1-Apparance
The section dedicated to 'Function description' is the heart of VF
because it describes in detail the actual operation of the function.
The first step lists the nodes involved in the specific function that
'make logic' and not, and for each of them the relative signals are
indicated in input and / or output.
In the description, if present, state machines are also inserted
relating to particular operating conditions.
An example is shown below.

slides.body:
and structured as a VF - Working CharacteristicsApparance
The 'Working characteristic' lists the function 'characteristics' of the function understood as the proxy values to
be used for that specific function to be used.
There are also information related to the activation of the operation.

slides.title: Strictly confidential. All contents in this document are property of Kineton s.r.l. 2018 and structured as a VF - CAN Wa
slides.body:
and structured as a VF - CAN WakeUPApparance
The section dedicated to the CAN WakeUP describes if this function, once activated, can wake up
the CAN network, as shown in the example table.

slides.title: Strictly confidential. All contents in this document are property of Kineton s.r.l. 2018 and structured as a VF - Diagno
slides.body:
and structured as a VF - Diagnosi e RecoveryApparance
The last part of a VF is dedicated to the diagnosis and to the recovery, if present.
Usually if the diagnosis is present for a function, this is described in this section. For further
information, we recommend viewing the CDD, a document dedicated only to the diagnosis in
which all the relative DTCs and the validation / invalidation conditions are meticulously
described.

DBC File -1-Appendix
A key tool that goes hand in hand with the writing of a VF is
the DBC file that is mapped for each CAN protocol, the
entire network of posts and the related signals. In the next
slide an example of a DBC file related to the BHCAN
network.

LIN File -1-Appendix
Another fundamental tool that goes hand in hand

mapped for the LIN protocol. In the next slide an

functionality.
